Definition: Ashkenaz, a Japhethite, also his descendants
BiblicalUsage: Ashkenaz is a son of Gomer, named three times, in the table of nations, in the chronicler's copy of it, and in Jeremiah's call to the nations against Babylon. The prophet says set ye up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, and call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni and Ashchenaz.
TheologicalSignificance: A name that runs from the table of nations to the fall of Babylon tells me that God calls the far nations by name, and that the same Ashkenaz who descends from Japheth is summoned to march against the greatest city on earth.
